stdout_tail:
-symfc               Use symfc for generating force constants
  --symfc-memshow       Show symfc memory usage with respect to cutoff
                        distance
  --symfc-projector     Symmetrize force constants by symfc projector
  --symfc-memsize SYMFC_MEMORY_SIZE
                        Memory size to estimate cutoff pair distance (GB)
  --spf                 Calculate spectral function
  --stp, --show-num-triplets
                        Show reduced number of triplets to be calculated at
                        specified grid points
  --sym-fc3q            Symmetrize fc3 in reciprocal space by index exchange
  --thm, --tetrahedron-method
                        Use tetrahedron method.
  --tmax TMAX           Maximum calculated temperature
  --tmin TMIN           Minimum calculated temperature
  --tt TRANSPORT_TYPE, --transport-type TRANSPORT_TYPE
                        Transport type of thermal conductivity calculation
  --ts TEMPERATURES [TEMPERATURES ...], --temperature TEMPERATURES [TEMPERATURES ...]
                        Temperatures for damping functions
  --tstep TSTEP         Calculated temperature step
  --uplo LAPACK_ZHEEV_UPLO
                        Lapack zheev UPLO for phonon solver (default: L)
  --v2                  Disable taking average in fc3-r2q transformation
                        around three atoms
  --wgp, --write-grid-points
                        Write grid address of irreducible grid points for
                        specified mesh numbers to ir_grid_address.yaml
  --write-collision     Write collision matrix and Gammas to files
  --write-gamma         Write imag-part of self energy to files
  --write-gamma-detail, --write_detailed_gamma
                        Write out detailed imag-part of self energy
  --write-phonon        Write all phonons on grid points to files
  --write-pp            Write phonon-phonon interaction strength
  --write-lbte-solution
                        Write direct solution of LBTE to hdf5 files
